name: breakpass
description: Let your AI agent reach you by WhatsApp, SMS or phone call, and see if you got it.

interface.longDescription:
BreakPass lets ChatGPT reach you when something needs your attention and you're away from the chat. It sends a WhatsApp message or SMS to your own verified phone number, or calls you and reads the message out loud.

Three ways to reach you:
- Inform: one message, no reply needed.
- Acknowledge: messages repeat until you confirm you saw it.
- Escalate: a message, then phone calls until you press 1 on a call.

Workflows run on BreakPass servers, so an alert keeps going even if the conversation ends. You can ask whether an alert was delivered or acknowledged, and cancel one that's no longer needed.

What you need: a BreakPass account with at least one verified phone number. You sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT only sees an alias for each verified number; phone numbers never appear in tool results.

Limitations:
- BreakPass only contacts numbers the account owner has verified and opted in. It can't message customers, contacts or lists.
- An acknowledgement means you saw the alert. It is not approval for any action.
- Calls can get through Do Not Disturb only if you allow it on your phone.
- SMS isn't offered in every country.
- Sending an alert uses your BreakPass account balance.
- Not for emergencies or life-safety use.
capabilities: Call you and read the alert aloud

Call me and read this out loud: the deploy is blocked waiting for me.
Did I acknowledge the last alert you sent me?

test_cases.prompt: Check my BreakPass setup, then text me: BreakPass is connected.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reports ready with the verified number's alias; one SMS sent; one-line summary returned; no phone number shown.

test_cases.prompt: Send me a WhatsApp: the weekly report is ready.
test_cases.expected_behavior: One WhatsApp delivered to the verified number; no follow-up or retries.

test_cases.prompt: Call me and read this out loud: the production deploy is blocked waiting for me.
test_cases.expected_behavior: One call placed; the first 300 characters are read aloud; the result reports the attempt.

test_cases.prompt: Escalate this to me until I acknowledge: the payment provider is returning errors.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The Escalate workflow starts with an idempotency key: a message, then a call. Once the call is answered and 1 is pressed, the status shows acknowledged with each attempt.

test_cases.prompt: Send me an alert that needs acknowledgement: disk is 95% full. Actually it's fixed, cancel it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The Acknowledge workflow starts, then is cancelled; the status shows cancelled and the unsent steps stopped.

test_cases.prompt: Text my whole customer list about our weekend sale.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Declines: BreakPass only contacts the owner's verified, opted-in numbers and isn't for marketing.
Declines and tells the user to call local emergency services; BreakPass is not for emergencies.
Declines: only verified number aliases can be used; explains how the owner verifies a number.

review.commerce_description: BreakPass does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Alerts draw on the owner's existing BreakPass account balance.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: WhatsApp, SMS and phone-call alerts to the owner's verified numbers; Inform, Acknowledge and Escalate workflows; delivery status and cancel.
